description: This file implements GSS-API related functions for curl, including GSS-API security context initialization, error display, and logging functions. It references external GSS-API headers and curl internal headers, and defines specific OID descriptors and functions for GSS-API in the context of curl.

methods.description: Logs GSS-API error statuses, combining major and minor errors into a human-readable message.
